coverage: The historical derived file covers 1961-2025, limited by the available euro-equivalent FX history. The shorter 1999-2025 file remains available for the post-euro period.
inflation: Not applied; use french_cpi_dec_dec_1960_2025.csv separately for French real returns.
caveat: This is a mechanical translation of USD-denominated series into EUR. It does not model the underlying geographic currency exposure of multinational companies. The pre-1999 FX history is expressed in euro-equivalent terms by the OECD series.
